_note_listener: Cameras / readers with "driver": "listener" listen on 127.0.0.1 only. If the camera is on another machine add to that device: "options": { "bind": "0.0.0.0", "secret": "<long random text>" } (the agent refuses a non-local bind without a secret; the camera sends it in the x-agent-secret header or as ?secret=). Remove this _note line if you like.
_note_serverUrl: serverUrl must be https:// (plain http only for localhost / a private LAN address, or set GATE_AGENT_ALLOW_HTTP=1).
